description: Set, change, or remove the account's monthly overage cap in USD (Pro/Scale). At the cap, anything that would add overage pauses — live sites once bandwidth is past the included pool, deploy checks, form submissions, new custom domains — and nothing more is billed, until the cap is raised or the UTC month resets. 0 = never pay overage; null removes the cap. Only change it when the account owner asks.

limit_usd.description: Monthly overage cap in USD (up to 2 decimals). null removes the cap.

name: set_spend_limit
title: Set spend limit
